Here is not a complete list of all the things, but only a demonstration of what we prepared.   as you already noticed in the game there are achievements, there is still a little left to get the rest of the things. You can write your ideas in - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/679120/discussions/0/2865910213624127222]Special topic[/url]

[b]Support us, it's very appreciated, as well as your help in getting all these trading stuff.

notes.title: DEEP SPACE ANOMALY v1.02
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33101453/c17de0b65ae4909d2f3bfda9cb152b7a830a9415.gif[/img]


[b]DEEP SPACE ANOMALY[/b]

[u]UPDATE v1.02[/u]
changes include:

- Added 40% of armor at the beginning of the first 3 waves.
- The first gun will cause more damage, the speed of bullets increased.
- The machine gun bullet speed is increased.
- The player speed and moves increased.
- Screen centering removed.
- Abilities are now given less frequently.
- Button tutorial at the beginning of the game removed.
- F1 Help.
- Returning to menu or clicking on exit forceing a game error fixed.
- Get achievements a little easier.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Release Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33101453/44cfe782ea2e1b3a6c20ff355d8adf930ee65b8a.gif[/img]
This is a very quick little post but with a very important info-nugget!
It's finally time & the date has been set!
It's been an amazing period and I can't wait to share the end product with everyone.

The release date is set for June 24h!

I remind you that by buying a game you will get a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/846360/DEEP_SPACE_ANOMALY_Soundtrack__ART/]free DLC[/url]
I've had a wonderful time with fantastic support and surrounded by warm talented people and can't thank everyone enough.
I really hope to see you there :D
